messages.content: How many miles is 37 km?

answers.text:
To convert kilometers to miles, you can use the conversion factor:

$$
1 \text{ km} = 0.621371 \text{ miles}
$$

So, for 37 km:

$$
37 \text{ km} \times 0.621371 \approx 23.39 \text{ miles}
$$

**Answer:** Approximately **23.4 miles**.

messages.content: How many kilometres is 18 miles?

answers.text:
To convert miles to kilometers, you can use the conversion factor:

1 mile = 1.60934 kilometers.

So, for 18 miles:

$$
18 \, \text{miles} \times 1.60934 \, \text{km/mile} \approx 29.07 \, \text{km}
$$

Therefore, **18 miles is approximately 29.07 kilometers**.

messages.content: How many pounds is 64 kg?

answers.text:
To convert kilograms to pounds, you can use the conversion factor:

$$
1 \, \text{kg} = 2.20462 \, \text{lb}
$$

So, for 64 kg:

$$
64 \, \text{kg} \times 2.20462 \, \frac{\text{lb}}{\text{kg}} \approx 141.19 \, \text{lb}
$$

**Answer:** Approximately **141.19 pounds**.

messages.content: The bag of flour holds 2.5 kg. How many pounds is that?

answers.text:
To convert kilograms to pounds, you can use the conversion factor:

$$
1 \, \text{kg} = 2.20462 \, \text{lb}
$$

So, for 2.5 kg:

$$
2.5 \, \text{kg} \times 2.20462 \, \text{lb/kg} \approx 5.51155 \, \text{lb}
$$

Therefore, the bag of flour weighs approximately **5.51 pounds**.
